verdict.rationale: Founder-facing plain-language guidance is a fair axis for a national company registry, so it applies. The evidence pack contains only two robots.txt HTTP 403 probes (mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in), and no content about explainers, step-by-step guides or non-lawyer documentation was retrieved. With no evidence of the capability, the verdict is none. Confidence is low because the absence reflects the access wall rather than an observed lack of guidance.
